name: Kuala Lumpur
title: Holidays in Kuala Lumpur
intro: Malaysia's capital, where the Petronas Towers rise over hawker stalls, temples and rainforest parks, and the beaches of Langkawi and Penang are a short flight away. Here's what Kuala Lumpur is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: The Petronas Twin Towers lit up above the Kuala Lumpur skyline at dusk

facts.label: Time difference
facts.value: 7 to 8 hrs ahead of the UK

facts.label: Plugs
facts.value: Type G · same as the UK

facts_note: Fill in the Malaysia Digital Arrival Card online before you land. Check entry rules on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: Kuala Lumpur is hot and humid all year, around 32°C. June to August and January to February tend to be drier. Heavy afternoon storms are common from October to November and in spring, but usually pass quickly.

things.name: Petronas Twin Towers
things.blurb: Walk the skybridge and visit the observation deck. The park below has free light shows.

things.name: Batu Caves
things.blurb: A huge limestone cave temple up 272 rainbow-painted steps.

things.name: Jalan Alor
things.blurb: A street of hawker stalls and restaurants that comes alive at night.

things.name: Merdeka Square
things.blurb: Colonial buildings around the square where independence was declared.

things.name: KL Forest Eco Park
things.blurb: A canopy walk through rainforest in the middle of the city.

things.name: Islamic Arts Museum
things.blurb: Beautiful tiles, textiles and manuscripts in a calm building.

faqs.question: How many days do you need in Kuala Lumpur?
faqs.answer: Two or three days, then head on to Penang, Langkawi or the Cameron Highlands.

faqs.question: Is Kuala Lumpur good for a stopover?
faqs.answer: Yes. It's cheap, with great food and easy airport trains.

faqs.question: How do you get from KLIA to the city?
faqs.answer: The KLIA Ekspres train takes about 30 minutes to KL Sentral.

faqs.question: Is Kuala Lumpur expensive?
faqs.answer: No. Food, transport and hotels are good value, especially compared with Singapore.
